title: Comprehensible Japanese — 節分（Setsubun）：豆まき・恵方巻き
description: Yuki from Comprehensible Japanese explains the Setsubun tradition (February 3rd bean-throwing festival) entirely in slow, clear Japanese with drawings and gestures. Covers 豆まき (bean throwing to ward off demons), 恵方巻き (lucky direction sushi rolls), and the cultural significance behind the custom. Part of the Comprehensible Japanese immersion series designed for learners.
creator: Comprehensible Japanese (Yuki Kimura)
